title: 基于MAP-Elites的第一人称射击游戏地图程序化生成
summary: 研究应用MAP-Elites算法生成FPS游戏地图，提出两种新地图表示法（点线、空间布局），相比传统方法能生成更高多样性和质量的地图。
summary_en: Applies MAP-Elites algorithm to generate FPS game maps, introduces two novel map representations (Point-Line, Spatial-Layout) that produce maps with higher diversity and quality than previous methods.
